title: Prudent Allocator instance configuration
description: Reaches the agent as AgentInvocation.config. Every field is a threshold this methodology compares the book against; none of them can loosen the TimeGate, which is the gateway's and is not configurable from here. Aumos resolves this file and deliberately does not validate instance config against it — a half-validator would report a pass it did not establish.

historyDays.description: Calendar days of daily bars to request, counting back from asOf. Longer than a bottom-up reader would ask for, because the question here is how far a position has already travelled.

concentrationHeadroom.description: How close to the mandate's maxPositionWeight a position may sit before this agent treats it as concentrated. 0.02 means a 15% cap starts drawing attention at 13%.

actOnlyIfWorth.description: The smallest change in a position's weight worth proposing, as a fraction of the book. Below it this agent returns WAIT rather than churning the portfolio for a rounding difference.
